## Suggested path

1. **Mathematical foundations** — logits, probabilities, likelihood, cross-entropy, loss, and gradients.
2. **Attention and Transformers** — queries, keys, values, scores, softmax, and causal masking.
3. **Data and the autoregressive objective** — tokenization, input-target shifting, and next-token prediction.
4. **Model and training** — blocks, optimization, validation, generation, and evaluation.
5. **Critical notes** — examine assumptions, counterexamples, and the limitations of metrics and representations.

This path describes the learning structure, not the implementation status of every component. The [detailed learning path](https://github.com/JM-Brun/llm-lab/blob/main/docs/learning-path.md) and [roadmap](https://github.com/JM-Brun/llm-lab/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md) define validation criteria.
